briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies frontier race as compute shortages deepen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has accelerated with multiple frontier labs releasing upgraded models this month. Funding remains robust while safety concerns mount around production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced reasoning; Anthropic countered with Claude 4 Opus; Google DeepMind deployed Gemini 2.5 Pro; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B; xAI pushed Grok-3; DeepSeek launched V3. Competition centers on agentic capabilities.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target multi-agent risks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA H200 shortages persist; Microsoft and Google announced new 100k GPU clusters; TSMC reports record AI chip orders for Q3.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory fragmentation slow US labs more than Chinese competitors by 2027?
